functions.description: Report whether the Varlink connection is idle (no queued messages or pending work).
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_is_connected
functions.description: Report whether the Varlink connection is currently established.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_flush
functions.description: Flush any queued outgoing data on the Varlink connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_close
functions.description: Close the underlying transport of the Varlink connection (without necessarily unref'ing the object).
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
After close, most I/O operations will fail; object may still need unref

functions.name: sd_varlink_flush_close_unref
functions.description: Flush pending data, close the connection, and unref the sd_varlink object. Returns NULL.
requirements: v may be NULL; if non-NULL it must be a valid sd_varlink*
After call, the passed reference must not be used

functions.name: sd_varlink_close_unref
functions.description: Close the connection and unref it in one step. Returns NULL.
requirements: v may be NULL; if non-NULL it must be a valid sd_varlink*
After call, the passed reference must not be used

functions.name: sd_varlink_send
functions.description: Queue a Varlink method call without waiting for a reply.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be a non-NULL method string
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant object representing parameters

functions.name: sd_varlink_sendb
functions.description: Queue a Varlink method call, building parameters from varargs using sd-json builder conventions; does not wait for a reply.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description compatible with sd-json

functions.name: sd_varlink_sendbo
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_sendb that builds a JSON object from the variadic key/value arguments using SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT and enqueues a method call that does not expect a reply. Use when you want to send a fire-and-forget Varlink request and supply parameters inline as JSON build arguments.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object
method must be a non-NULL string naming the remote method (typically "interface.method")
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification (i.e., valid sd-json key/value builder pairs)
The connection should be established before calling (i.e., created/connected via one of sd_varlink_connect_* functions)
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_call_full
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_call_full(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant *parameters, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, sd_varlink_reply_flags_t *ret_flags);
functions.description: Send a method call and synchronously wait for a reply, returning reply parameters, error id (if any), and reply flags.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant
ret_parameters may be NULL or must be non-NULL to receive a referenced sd_json_variant* on success; caller is responsible for freeing per sd-json rules
ret_error_id may be NULL or non-NULL to receive an error identifier string (valid until object cleanup; exact lifetime unspecified)
ret_flags may be NULL or non-NULL to receive sd_varlink_reply_flags_t

functions.name: sd_varlink_call
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_call(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant *parameters, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id);
functions.description: Send a method call and wait for a single reply, returning parameters and error id if any.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant
ret_parameters and ret_error_id follow the same rules as sd_varlink_call_full

functions.name: sd_varlink_callb_ap
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_callb_ap(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, sd_varlink_reply_flags_t *ret_flags, va_list ap);
functions.description: Send a method call with parameters built from a va_list using sd-json builder semantics, and wait for reply, returning parameters/error/flags.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
ap must be a valid, initialized va_list containing a valid sd-json object build description
ret_parameters/ret_error_id/ret_flags may be NULL or valid pointers to receive results

functions.name: sd_varlink_callb_full
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_callb_full(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, sd_varlink_reply_flags_t *ret_flags, ...);
functions.description: Variadic form to send a method call with parameters built from varargs using sd-json builder semantics and wait for a reply including flags.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description
ret_parameters/ret_error_id/ret_flags may be NULL or valid pointers

functions.name: sd_varlink_callbo_full
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_callbo_full(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, sd_varlink_reply_flags_t *ret_flags, ...);
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_callb_full that builds the request parameters as a JSON object from variadic arguments and performs a synchronous method call, waiting for a reply. Returns the reply payload, error id (if any), and reply flags.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object
method must be a non-NULL string naming the remote method (typically "interface.method")
ret_parameters, ret_error_id, and ret_flags point to storage for results; they may be set on success; caller is responsible for handling any returned objects as required by sd-json/sd-varlink APIs
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification
Connection should be established prior to calling
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_callb
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_callb(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, ...);
functions.description: Variadic form to send a method call and wait for a single reply; parameters are built from varargs using sd-json semantics.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description
ret_parameters/ret_error_id may be NULL or valid pointers

functions.name: sd_varlink_callbo
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_callbo(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, ...);
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_callb that builds the request parameters as a JSON object from variadic arguments and performs a synchronous method call, waiting for a single final reply. Returns the reply payload and error id, but not reply flags.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object
method must be a non-NULL string naming the remote method
ret_parameters and ret_error_id must be valid pointers for outputs; caller must handle returned objects per sd-json/sd-varlink rules
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification
Connection should be established prior to calling
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_collect_full
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_collect_full(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant *parameters, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, sd_varlink_reply_flags_t *ret_flags);
functions.description: Send a method call and collect a sequence of 'more' replies into an array until a final reply arrives; return the collected array, error id, and flags.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant
ret_parameters must be non-NULL to receive the collected result array (as sd_json_variant*)
ret_error_id/ret_flags may be NULL or valid pointers

functions.name: sd_varlink_collect
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_collect(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant *parameters, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id);
functions.description: Send a method call and collect all 'more' replies into an array, returning the array and error id.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant
ret_parameters must be non-NULL to receive the array
ret_error_id may be NULL or a valid pointer

functions.name: sd_varlink_collectb
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_collectb(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, ...);
functions.description: Variadic form to send a method call and collect replies into an array; parameters are built from varargs using sd-json semantics.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
method must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description
ret_parameters must be non-NULL to receive the array
ret_error_id may be NULL or valid pointer

functions.name: sd_varlink_collectbo
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_collectbo(sd_varlink *v, const char *method, sd_json_variant **ret_parameters, const char **ret_error_id, ...);
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_collectb that builds the request parameters as a JSON object from variadic arguments and performs a call that may produce multiple 'more' replies. It collects all intermediate replies and the final reply into an array, returned via ret_parameters.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object
method must be a non-NULL string naming the remote method
ret_parameters and ret_error_id must be valid pointers for outputs; ret_parameters will receive a JSON array on success per the collect semantics
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification
Connection should be established prior to calling
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_invoke
functions.description: Queue a method call and expect its reply to be delivered asynchronously to the bound reply callback.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
A reply callback must be bound with sd_varlink_bind_reply() to receive replies
method must be non-NULL
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant

functions.name: sd_varlink_invokeb
functions.description: Variadic form to queue a method call; parameters are built from varargs using sd-json semantics; replies are delivered via callback.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
A reply callback should be bound with sd_varlink_bind_reply()
method must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description

functions.name: sd_varlink_invokebo
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_invokeb that builds the request parameters as a JSON object from variadic arguments and enqueues a method call where a reply is expected later and delivered via the reply callback bound with sd_varlink_bind_reply.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object
method must be a non-NULL string naming the remote method
A reply callback should be bound beforehand via sd_varlink_bind_reply to receive the eventual response
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification
Connection should be established prior to calling
Caller must drive the event loop or call sd_varlink_process/sd_varlink_wait to receive the reply
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_observe
functions.description: Queue a method call and expect a reply now and possibly more later; all are delivered via the reply callback (observe pattern).
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
A reply callback must be bound with sd_varlink_bind_reply()
method must be non-NULL
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant

functions.name: sd_varlink_observeb
functions.description: Variadic form of observe; parameters built from varargs using sd-json semantics; replies delivered via callback.
requirements: v must be a valid, connected sd_varlink*
A reply callback must be bound with sd_varlink_bind_reply()
method must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description

functions.name: sd_varlink_observebo
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_observeb that builds the request parameters as a JSON object from variadic arguments and enqueues a method call that expects an immediate reply and possibly additional 'more' replies, all delivered asynchronously to the bound reply callback.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object
method must be a non-NULL string naming the remote method
A reply callback should be bound beforehand via sd_varlink_bind_reply to receive replies (initial and any 'more')
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification
Connection should be established prior to calling
Caller must drive the event loop or call sd_varlink_process/sd_varlink_wait to receive replies
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_reply
functions.description: Enqueue a final reply to the currently handled incoming method call.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant

functions.name: sd_varlink_replyb
functions.description: Variadic form to enqueue a final reply; parameters built from varargs using sd-json semantics.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description

functions.name: sd_varlink_replybo
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_replyb that builds a JSON object from variadic arguments and enqueues a final reply to the currently handled incoming method call on the server side.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object associated with a server-side handler context
Must be called while handling an incoming request (i.e., within a method callback) to send the final reply
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification for the reply parameters
Mutually exclusive with sending an error for the same request
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_error
functions.description: Enqueue a final error reply with the given error identifier and optional parameters.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
error_id must be a non-NULL error string identifier
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant

functions.name: sd_varlink_errorb
functions.description: Variadic form to enqueue a final error reply; parameters built from varargs using sd-json semantics.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
error_id must be non-NULL
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description

functions.name: sd_varlink_errorbo
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_errorb that builds a JSON object from variadic arguments and enqueues a (final) error reply with the specified error_id to the currently handled incoming method call on the server side.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object associated with a server-side handler context
error_id must be a non-NULL, valid Varlink error identifier (e.g., SD_VARLINK_ERROR_* or spec-defined)
Must be called while handling an incoming request (i.e., within a method callback)
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification for the error parameters (may be empty if not needed)
Mutually exclusive with sending a successful reply for the same request
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_error_invalid_parameter
functions.description: Enqueue an InvalidParameter error reply with the provided parameters.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant describing the invalid parameter(s)

functions.name: sd_varlink_error_invalid_parameter_name
functions.description: Enqueue an InvalidParameter error referring to a specific parameter name.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
name must be a non-NULL parameter name string

functions.name: sd_varlink_error_errno
functions.description: Enqueue an error reply mapping a system errno to a Varlink error id and parameters.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
error should be a valid errno value

functions.name: sd_varlink_notify
functions.description: Enqueue a 'more' (non-final) reply for the current call, indicating further replies will follow.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant

functions.name: sd_varlink_notifyb
functions.description: Variadic form to enqueue a 'more' reply; parameters built from varargs using sd-json semantics.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* and currently handling an incoming call
Varargs must form a valid sd-json object/build description

functions.name: sd_varlink_notifybo
functions.description: Convenience macro wrapper around sd_varlink_notifyb that builds a JSON object from variadic arguments and enqueues a non-final 'more' reply to the currently handled incoming method call on the server side.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink connection object associated with a server-side handler context
Must be called while handling an incoming request that allows multiple replies (i.e., method negotiated with MORE/notify semantics)
Variadic arguments must form a valid SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT specification for the notification parameters
If a final reply or error has already been sent for the current request, further notify calls are invalid
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_dispatch_again
functions.description: Request that the current incoming message be dispatched again (e.g., after partial handling).
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* currently handling an incoming message

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_current_method
functions.description: Retrieve the method string of the message currently being processed.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* during message handling
ret must be non-NULL to receive a pointer to the method string (lifetime tied to the connection/message; exact details unspecified)

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_current_parameters
functions.description: Retrieve the parameters of the message currently being processed.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* during message handling
ret must be non-NULL to receive a sd_json_variant* (ownership/lifetime per sd-json; exact details unspecified)

functions.name: sd_varlink_dispatch
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_dispatch(sd_varlink *v, sd_json_variant *parameters, const sd_json_dispatch_field dispatch_table[], void *userdata);
functions.description: Parse parameters via json_dispatch() using the provided dispatch table and generate a suitable error on parse errors.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
parameters may be NULL or a valid sd_json_variant to parse
dispatch_table must point to a valid, NULL-terminated sd_json_dispatch_field array compatible with sd-json
userdata is passed through to dispatch handlers

functions.name: sd_varlink_push_fd
functions.description: Associate an outgoing file descriptor with the next outgoing message.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
fd must be a valid open file descriptor
FD passing must be enabled for output on this connection/server or the call will fail

functions.name: sd_varlink_push_dup_fd
functions.description: Duplicate and associate a file descriptor with the next outgoing message.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
fd must be a valid open file descriptor
FD passing must be enabled for output

functions.name: sd_varlink_reset_fds
functions.description: Clear any queued outgoing file descriptors associated with the next message.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_peek_fd
functions.description: Return the i-th incoming file descriptor for the currently handled message without taking ownership.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* during message handling
i is a zero-based index less than the number of received fds
FD passing must be allowed on input for this connection/server or the message must have included fds

functions.name: sd_varlink_peek_dup_fd
functions.description: Duplicate and return the i-th incoming file descriptor for the current message without removing it from the queue.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* during message handling
i must be within range of available fds

functions.name: sd_varlink_take_fd
functions.description: Take ownership of the i-th incoming file descriptor for the current message (removes it from the queue).
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* during message handling
i must be within range of available fds

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_n_fds
functions.description: Return the number of incoming file descriptors available for the currently handled message.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink* during message handling

functions.name: sd_varlink_set_allow_fd_passing_input
functions.description: Enable or disable receiving file descriptors on this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
b is treated as boolean (0 to disable, non-zero to enable)

functions.name: sd_varlink_set_allow_fd_passing_output
functions.description: Enable or disable sending file descriptors on this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
b is treated as boolean (0 to disable, non-zero to enable)

functions.name: sd_varlink_bind_reply
functions.description: Bind a reply callback that will receive asynchronous replies/errors for invoke/observe calls on this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
reply must be a valid function pointer with the signature sd_varlink_reply_t; may be NULL to clear callback (behavior unspecified)
The callback must be reentrant-safe with respect to sd-varlink processing as applicable

functions.name: sd_varlink_set_userdata
functions.description: Attach arbitrary userdata pointer to the connection, returning the previous value.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_userdata
functions.description: Return the userdata pointer associated with the connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_peer_uid
functions.description: Return the peer's UID associated with this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
ret must be non-NULL to receive the UID
May fail if peer credentials are unavailable

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_peer_gid
functions.description: Return the peer's GID associated with this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
ret must be non-NULL to receive the GID
May fail if peer credentials are unavailable

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_peer_pid
functions.description: Return the peer's PID associated with this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
ret must be non-NULL to receive the PID
May fail if peer credentials are unavailable

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_peer_pidfd
functions.description: Return a pidfd referring to the peer process, if available.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
Kernel/userspace support for pidfd must be available; otherwise a negative error is returned

functions.name: sd_varlink_set_relative_timeout
functions.description: Set a relative timeout (microseconds) for connection operations or pending requests.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
timeout is a relative interval in microseconds (exact semantics unspecified)

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_server
functions.description: Return the server object that owns this connection, if any (for server-side connections).
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_set_description
functions.description: Set a human-readable description for this connection.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*
d may be NULL or a UTF-8 string; length limits unspecified

functions.name: sd_varlink_get_description
functions.description: Get the human-readable description of this connection, if set.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_set_input_sensitive
functions.description: Mark parameters of incoming messages on this connection as security sensitive for logging/auditing.
requirements: v must be a valid sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_new
functions.description: Create a new Varlink server with the specified flags and return it via ret.
requirements: ret must be non-NULL
flags is a bitmask of sd_varlink_server_flags_t controlling server behavior
Caller must unref the server with sd_varlink_server_unref() when done

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_ref
functions.description: Increase the reference count of a Varlink server and return the same pointer.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server* (may be NULL if allowed; NULL-handling unspecified)

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_unref
functions.description: Decrease the reference count of a Varlink server and free it when it drops to zero. Returns NULL.
requirements: s must be NULL or a valid sd_varlink_server*
After unref returns, the passed reference must not be used

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_set_info
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_server_set_info(sd_varlink_server *s, const char *vendor, const char *product, const char *version, const char *url);
functions.description: Set informational metadata (vendor/product/version/url) exposed by the server.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
vendor/product/version/url may be NULL or UTF-8 strings; specific constraints unspecified

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_listen_address
functions.description: Add a listening address to the server. If SD_VARLINK_SERVER_MODE_MKDIR_0755 is ORed into mode, create parent directories with 0755.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
address must be a non-NULL address string understood by this library
mode specifies the socket/node permissions; may include SD_VARLINK_SERVER_MODE_MKDIR_0755 flag

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_listen_fd
functions.description: Have the server listen on an already created/listening file descriptor.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
fd must be a valid, appropriate listening socket fd

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_listen_auto
functions.description: Automatically add one or more listening endpoints based on server configuration or environment (e.g., socket activation).
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
May depend on environment (like socket activation) being set up; specifics unspecified

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_listen_name
functions.description: Listen on a well-known name (address resolved internally).
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
name must be a non-NULL identifier understood by this implementation

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_add_connection
functions.description: Adopt an already accepted client connection (single fd) into the server and return the created sd_varlink connection.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
fd must be a valid connected fd to a client
ret must be non-NULL to receive the new sd_varlink*

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_add_connection_pair
functions.signature: int sd_varlink_server_add_connection_pair(sd_varlink_server *s, int input_fd, int output_fd, const struct ucred *override_ucred, sd_varlink **ret);
functions.description: Adopt an already accepted client connection given as separate input/output fds, optionally overriding credentials, and return the connection.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
input_fd and output_fd must be valid connected fds
override_ucred may be NULL or point to a valid struct ucred
ret must be non-NULL

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_add_connection_stdio
functions.description: Adopt the connection from standard I/O file descriptors (stdin/stdout) as a server-side connection.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
ret must be non-NULL
Caller must ensure stdio fds are connected appropriately

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_bind_method
functions.description: Bind a server-side implementation callback to a fully-qualified Varlink method name.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
method must be a non-NULL method string
callback must be a valid function pointer with signature sd_varlink_method_t

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_bind_method_many_internal
functions.description: Internal variadic helper to bind multiple methods at once (terminated by NULL).
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
Varargs must follow the expected pattern for binding multiple methods (details unspecified); must be terminated by NULL

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_bind_method_many
functions.description: Variadic convenience macro that forwards to sd_varlink_server_bind_method_many_internal(s, ..., NULL). It binds multiple method name to callback pairs to a server in one call. The macro appends a NULL terminator automatically.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server object

Variadic arguments are expected to be repeated pairs of (const char* method, sd_varlink_method_t callback), inferred from sd_varlink_server_bind_method signature; the list is terminated implicitly by the macro adding a trailing NULL
Each method string should be non-NULL and each callback should be a valid function pointer
Returns negative errno-style error codes on failure; callers must check the return value

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_bind_connect
functions.description: Bind a callback that is invoked when a new client connects to the server.
requirements: s must be a valid sd_varlink_server*
connect must be a valid function pointer of type sd_varlink_connect_t

functions.name: sd_varlink_server_bind_disconnect

requirements: udev_enumerate must be valid.
Caller must check integer return.

functions.name: udev_enumerate_get_list_entry
functions.description: Get the head of the resulting list of entries after a scan. Iterate with udev_list_entry_foreach().
requirements: udev_enumerate must be valid and a scan should have been run to populate results (inferred).
Returned list entries are owned by libudev; do not free.

functions.name: udev_queue_ref
functions.description: Increase the reference count of a udev queue object and return the same pointer.
requirements: udev_queue must be a valid queue pointer.
Balance with udev_queue_unref().

functions.name: udev_queue_unref
functions.description: Decrease the reference count of a udev queue object. When it reaches zero, the object is destroyed. Returns the object or NULL (unknown).
requirements: udev_queue must be valid and not already freed.
Do not use after final unref.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_udev
functions.description: Get the libudev context that owns this queue.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Returned context is owned by libudev; do not unref unless you hold a ref (inferred).

functions.name: udev_queue_new
functions.description: Create a new queue object to inspect the current udev event processing queue.
requirements: udev must be a valid context.
Caller must check for NULL return and unref the object when done.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_kernel_seqnum
functions.signature: unsigned long long int udev_queue_get_kernel_seqnum(struct udev_queue *udev_queue) __attribute__((__deprecated__));
functions.description: Get the current kernel uevent sequence number. Deprecated.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Caller must handle deprecation and potential unavailability (inferred).

functions.name: udev_queue_get_udev_seqnum
functions.signature: unsigned long long int udev_queue_get_udev_seqnum(struct udev_queue *udev_queue) __attribute__((__deprecated__));
functions.description: Get the current udev daemon sequence number. Deprecated.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Caller must handle deprecation and potential unavailability (inferred).

functions.name: udev_queue_get_udev_is_active
functions.description: Check whether the udev daemon is active. Returns nonzero if active, 0 otherwise.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_queue_is_empty
functions.description: Check whether the udev event queue is currently empty. Returns nonzero if empty, 0 if events are pending.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_seqnum_is_finished
functions.signature: int udev_queue_get_seqnum_is_finished(struct udev_queue *udev_queue, unsigned long long int seqnum) __attribute__((__deprecated__));
functions.description: Check if the specified sequence number has finished processing. Deprecated.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Caller must handle deprecation.
Caller must check integer return.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_seqnum_sequence_is_finished
functions.signature: int udev_queue_get_seqnum_sequence_is_finished(struct udev_queue *udev_queue, unsigned long long int start, unsigned long long int end) __attribute__((__deprecated__));
functions.description: Check if the inclusive range of sequence numbers has finished processing. Deprecated.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Caller must handle deprecation.
Caller must check integer return.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_fd
functions.description: Get a file descriptor that can be polled to wait for udev queue changes (e.g., emptiness).
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Return is a non-negative fd on success; ownership and close semantics are unspecified (unknown).

functions.name: udev_queue_flush
functions.description: Block until the current udev event queue is drained (flushed). Returns 0 on success, negative on error (unknown exact codes).
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Caller must check integer return and be prepared for blocking behavior.

functions.name: udev_queue_get_queued_list_entry
functions.description: Get a list of currently queued events. Deprecated.
requirements: udev_queue must be valid.
Returned list entries are owned by libudev; do not free.
Caller must handle deprecation.

functions.name: udev_hwdb_new
functions.description: Create a new handle to the static hardware database (hwdb) for property lookups.
requirements: udev must be a valid context.
Caller must check for NULL return and unref with udev_hwdb_unref() when done.

functions.name: udev_hwdb_ref
functions.description: Increase the reference count of a hwdb handle and return the same pointer.
requirements: hwdb must be a valid hwdb pointer.
Balance with udev_hwdb_unref().

functions.name: udev_hwdb_unref
functions.description: Decrease the reference count of a hwdb handle. When it reaches zero, the handle is destroyed. Returns the handle or NULL (unknown).
requirements: hwdb must be valid and not already freed.
Do not use after final unref.

functions.name: udev_hwdb_get_properties_list_entry
functions.signature: struct udev_list_entry* udev_hwdb_get_properties_list_entry(struct udev_hwdb *hwdb, const char *modalias, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Query the hardware database with a given modalias and flags and return a list of matched properties as key/value entries.
requirements: hwdb must be valid.
modalias must be a non-NULL string understood by hwdb.
flags is an unsigned bitmask; valid values are unspecified here (unknown).
Returned list entries are owned by libudev; do not free.

functions.name: udev_util_encode_string
functions.signature: int udev_util_encode_string(const char *str, char *str_enc, size_t len);
functions.description: Encode an arbitrary string into a udev-safe representation and store it in the provided buffer. Returns the number of bytes written or a status code (unknown exact semantics).
requirements: str must be a non-NULL input string.
str_enc must point to a writable buffer.
len must specify the size of str_enc in bytes and should be large enough to hold the encoded string including terminator if applicable.
Caller must check the integer return to detect truncation or errors (semantics unspecified).

data_types.description: A textual 128-bit identifier accepted by systemd’s sd_id128 parser: either a 32-character hexadecimal string (lower/upper case allowed) without separators, or a UUID-style string (8-4-4-4-12 hex digits with hyphens). No surrounding whitespace; NUL-terminated.

A newline-separated list of KEY=VALUE assignments used by sd_notify* to communicate service status to systemd. Typical keys include READY=1, STATUS=..., MAINPID=..., WATCHDOG=1, etc. Each assignment is ASCII text; overall buffer is NUL-terminated. Lines separated by \n.
A NUL-terminated string representing a file system path (absolute or relative). May include directories, filenames, and standard POSIX path characters.
An arbitrary human-readable NUL-terminated string without prescribed structure. May contain any bytes except embedded NUL.

A NUL-terminated token naming a memory pressure category/type for systemd’s memory pressure event sources (e.g., low/medium/critical or similar). Exact accepted values depend on the API implementation.
